name: letta-block
title: Letta Block
description: Flat structure summary of the Letta Block entity, derived from the Letta OpenAPI 1.0.0 spec.

fields.name: template_name
fields.description: Name of the block if it is a template.

fields.name: is_template
fields.description: Whether the block is a template (e.g. saved human/persona options).

fields.name: base_template_id
fields.description: The base template id of the block.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: The id of the entity within the template.

fields.name: preserve_on_migration
fields.description: Preserve the block on template migration.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Label of the block (e.g. 'human', 'persona') in the context window.

fields.name: read_only
fields.description: Whether the agent has read-only access to the block.

fields.name: hidden
fields.description: If set to True, the block will be hidden.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The human-friendly ID of the Block

fields.name: created_by_id
fields.description: The id of the user that made this Block.

fields.name: last_updated_by_id
fields.description: The id of the user that last updated this Block.

fields.name: tags
fields.description: The tags associated with the block.
